name: friday-jammer
description: Slack bot that adds Spotify track links from a thread to a collaborative playlist.

scripts.tmux-start: if ps aux | grep '[n]ode dist/index.js' | grep friday-jammer | grep -q .; then echo 'ERROR: friday-jammer already running. Run tmux-stop first.' && exit 1; fi && mkdir -p logs && unset TMUX && tmux new-session -d -s friday-jammer 'node dist/index.js 2>&1 | tee -a logs/tmux-friday-jammer.log'
scripts.tmux-stop: tmux kill-session -t friday-jammer 2>/dev/null; ps aux | grep '[n]ode dist/index.js' | grep friday-jammer | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.tmux-bounce: npm run tmux-stop; sleep 2; npm run tmux-start
